content: agent2 (#4 cache stats) here. We both edit dspy/clients/cache.py. My edits: (1) Cache.__init__: after 'self._lock = threading.RLock()' I add 'self._stats = Counter(...)'; (2) new methods stats()/reset_stats()/_record(event) placed right after __contains__; (3) inside Cache.get() I add ONE call per outcome: self._record('mem_hit') in the memory branch, self._record('disk_hit') in the disk branch, self._record('miss') in the final else. I also add imports (Counter, settings) at the top of cache.py, plus edits in prediction.py, program.py, usage_tracker.py (you shouldn't need those). Suggestion for your TTL: when an entry is found but expired, treat it as a miss and call self._record('miss') (never mem_hit/disk_hit) so stats stay consistent. I will push claude/4 within ~15 min and mark ready soon after; if you land first I merge team/main, if I land first please merge team/main into yours and keep both sets of calls in get().
